offer.name: Agent Spend Containment Sprint
offer.payment_collection: CUSTOMER_SPECIFIC_INVOICE (invoice rail already recorded in revenue/outcome_commerce/catalog.json); NOT_PROVIDED_ON_THIS_PAGE

milestones.due: on the buyer's written acceptance of the scope: trigger evidence seen, workflow and provider named, ceilings agreed, staging confirmed
on acceptance PASS; on MISS by window end, refunded or one free repair attempt in the next five business days, buyer's written choice

offer.qualifying_trigger: one provider bill for one agent workflow up at least 3x month over month, or one incident of at least $1,000 inside seven days, shown as the provider's own cost report with amounts only
offer.buyer: engineering lead who owns one production agent workflow at a company of roughly 5 to 200 engineers, paying OpenAI or Anthropic directly or through a gateway they run, with a staging copy they can execute

boundary.delivery_form: pull request into the buyer's repository or a tarball; staging only; no production writes
boundary.evidence_received: traces and logs with secrets redacted; cost reports as amounts; no production data, PII or PHI

delivery: cost meter: provider usage fields to USD per call from a pinned price table; one append-only usage event per call (metering-event.schema.json USAGE_RECORDED shape) with idempotency_key and correlation_id
per-run and rolling dollar and token ledger with ceilings agreed in writing

predicates evaluated before the next provider call: step cap, wall-clock deadline, token ceiling, dollar ceiling (per run and rolling), per-tool quota with mutating tools counted separately, no-progress and oscillation detection, external abort flag
clean abort: incident record (run id, spend at halt, predicate, last N calls, resumable state pointer) and one alert to the buyer's channel
idempotency wrapper for every mutating external effect (survival_canary.py pattern)
staged runaway regression test and normal-run test, receipts hash-stable on re-run
handoff: source snapshot at an exact commit, one-command run, versions, both receipts with hashes, walkthrough, keep/change/stop note
staged_runaway_shapes: healthy-looking iteration with no progress until the turn cap
offer.acceptance: Given the buyer's staging harness with the controls installed and per-run ceiling C and rolling daily ceiling D agreed in writing, when the staged runaway is started, the run halts before cumulative spend reaches C and its incident record names run id, spend at halt, the predicate that fired and a resumable state, and every mutating external effect fired at most once; and when a normal run of the same workflow is started, it completes, its receipt attributes cost per run and per model, and the receipt is byte-identical on a second run of the same input. PASS only if all of it holds inside the agreed window.
exclusions: credentials, production migration, hosting, SLA, ongoing monitoring, multi-tenant chargeback, model-file or White Box work
disqualifiers: no staging harness the buyer can run, or the failure only reproduces on production data
workflow already behind a gateway with tested per-session budgets and iteration caps (LiteLLM max_budget_per_session / max_iterations); then only the $2,500 staged proof applies
more than one provider or an unpinnable model router
PHI or regulated data in the traces we would receive
buyer wants us to hold keys, host anything, or sign an SLA
